method: DevTools Console operated through Windows computer-use. DOM actions, React readback, reopening popups, Resource Timing and remote-image load checks. No credentials or profile values exported.
resolves: Seven needs_review bindings from kufar-authenticated-review.json; its initial input/capture blocker is historical.

multi_select.verification: Apply, wait for popup removal, reopen, compare the full checked-label set, Apply to close. The first 100ms fixed-delay attempt failed because the popup had not finished closing; polling the DOM lifecycle resolved it.

vehicle_vin.scope: Synthetic text transfer and replacement only; no claim of real VIN validity, report purchase, vehicle decoding or server publication validation.

possible_exchange.failed_approaches: Rapid batched input.click()/label.click() tests intermittently read the previous state; a later timed loop also failed. These runs are not counted as acceptance.
possible_exchange.accepted_approach: Separate guarded actions on [data-name=possible_exchange] [role=checkbox], with native input.checked read in a subsequent console command after React processing.

fixtures.reason: Counter did not increase; cause not captured, no claim of a minimum size or duplicate detection.

images.acceptance: Require expected count AND remote src AND complete/naturalWidth; the non-incrementing attempt must never be reported as success.
